content.text: Class: prototype strong μ-r agonist            -major analgesic in crude opium
Admin: PO, IV, rectal, SC, intrathecal, SL
Met: least lipophilic (little crosses BBB) BUT cross placenta → ⍉use in labor
morphine-3-glucuronide (neuroexcite → accum → neurotox, myoclonus, delirium, sz; ↑risk renal insuff)
: cell wall synthesis inhibitor & inhibitor or proteases & other bacterial enzymes; mixture of cyclic peptides that are bactericidal & bacteriostatic
•gram (+) only; little effect against gram (-) & anaerobes
•topical preparation for minor skin injuries, scrapes, cuts, & burns
•may be part of triple therapy ointment w/ Neomycin & Polymyxin B
•topical: allergic contact dermatitis – pts w/ allergic reaction to Neomycin may also be sensitive to Bacitracin
•IM: nephrotoxic (so primarily used in topical form)

roles.drugs: Pain: IV opioids (eg, morphine), large doses may be needed
Partial-thickness and deeper burns: a topical antimicrobial (silver sulfadiazine; mafenide acetate for deep burns, penetrates eschar) or a silver/absorptive occlusive dressing
